scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.speaker: Player
scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.text: You've been staring at that photo for a while.

scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.text: I just want to go back home.

scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.text: \Makauli once more, before... before I get too old to travel.

scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.speaker: Player
scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.text: Then let's go. Talk to Dad.

choices.label: I'll help you plan it, Grandma. We're really going.
I don't really know much about Aklan, but fine, let's try.
Isn't that too far? You might have a hard time, Grandma.

scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.text: \Saeamat, \Apo. This old heart needed to hear that.

scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.text: That's alright. You'll learn — the language will teach you where you're from.

scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.text: Maybe. But some things are worth being tired for.

scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.text: I'll tell your father about our plan

scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_1_a_house_abroad_evening.text: You go to your room and go check your notebook.

scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.speaker: Papa Jobert
scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.text: Same humidity as I remember, huh, Ma.

scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.speaker: Player
scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.text: I want to say it right when we meet Aunt Susan.

scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.text: Practice makes it stick. We have time.

scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.speaker: Papa Jobert
scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.text: Come on, Aunt Susan is at the parking lot already.

scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_2_kalibo_international_airport_arr.text: Do you want to try again?

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: \alin \hambae \mo?

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Rose
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: (mumbles) So this is the \balikbayan cousin, huh.

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Rose
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: Lola Susan is asking if you are [Player]

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Player
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: Oh they are at the Entrance

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Rose
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: Also where is Lola Jonabel and your Papa Jobert?

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: Rose! I told you, introduce yourself.

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: [Player], This is my \apo Rose

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: She will help you learn \akeanon from now on

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Rose
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: (sighs) Fine. But don't expect me to go easy on you

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Player
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: I mean... I did fly like 14 hours, so a little easy would be nice.

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Rose
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: 14 hours doesn't teach you a language.
What's your answer to Rose?

choices.label: Deal. Teach me everything, I'm serious about this.
We'll see how it goes. No promises I'll be good at it.
I don't even know if I need this, honestly.

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Rose
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: Good. Don't waste my time then, balikbayan.

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Rose
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: Fair enough. Effort matters more than talent anyway.

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Rose
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: Then why'd you come? ...whatever. Your loss if you don't try.

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Rose
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: Sunod kamo. I'll show you the town.

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: \Mayad \man \nga \agahon!

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Player
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: Are you Lola Susan?

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: Yes

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: Ahh, \ikaw \siguro \si [Player]

scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.text: \Siin \si Lola Jonabel ag  Papa jobert \mo?
scene_3_kalibo_town_proper_reunion.translation: Where is your Lola Jonabel and Papa Jobert?

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Okay, quick drill before we go home. Focus, balikbayan.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: "\Ako" that means "I" or "me"

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: "\Ikaw"  means "you"

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: "\Imaw" means "he/she or him/her"

questions.question: What akeanon word has the meaning "he/she or him/her"

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Well Done!

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Nice try, we can try again later

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Next are words used when talking about multiple people

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: In \akeanon we have  two words for "we"

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: There is "\kita" meaning "we including you" or "us"

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: There is also "\kami" meaning "we excluding you"

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Then we have "\kamo" which means "you" when talking about multiple people

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Also we have "\sanda" which means "they or them"

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: I have a few more common words to teach you

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Do you want a review now or we can do it later?

choices.label: Sure, Quiz me now to make sure I got it

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: That's what I like to hear.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Do you know how to count to five(5)?

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Really? Let's play a game then

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Wow! You know more than I thought.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: It's OK, I'll teach you again as a refresher

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: It's fine we can review again when we get home

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Well Done! You're a natural

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Player
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Ok I'll teach you one(1) to five(5) for now

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: One(1) is "\isaea"

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Two(2) is "\daywa"

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Three(3) is "\tatlo"

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Four(4) is "\ap-at"

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Five(5) is "\lima"

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Let's play a game to see if you got it.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Ok we can try again at home

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Well Done

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Let's go home.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_family.text: Do you want to play agin?

low.text: Kadugay ko na di nakatilaw sang kan-on nga tumbien sa balay ni Susan.
Napahiling si Lola Jonabel sa bintana, nakangiti nang walang partikular na dahilan.

med.speaker: Lola Jonabel
med.text: Player, do not forget to write to your Lola back home too. Distance should never mean silence.

med.speaker: Lola Jonabel
med.text: Kung pagod ka na, Apo, sabihin mo lang. Hindi kailangan lahat ngayon din matutunan.

med.speaker: Lola Jonabel
med.text: This town raised me before it raised your Tita Susan. Funny how it still feels the same.

med.speaker: Lola Jonabel
med.text: Marami pang lugar dito na gusto kong ipakita sa'yo, Apo. Isa-isa lang.

med.speaker: Lola Jonabel
med.text: Alam mo, kahit gaano man katagal, parang kailan lang 'yong huling beses ko dito.

high.text: Hinihipo ni Lola Jonabel ang lumang litrato sa kanyang bag, hindi napapansin na napapangiti siya.

low.text: Kinukuha ni Papa Jobert ang kanyang phone, kunwari kukuha ng litrato pero halatang nostalgic lang.
Napapatango-tango si Papa Jobert habang naglalakad, parang bawat kanto may kwento.

med.speaker: Papa Jobert
med.text: Grabe 'to, parang bata ulit ako pag nandito. Sobrang dami ng memories, anak.

med.speaker: Papa Jobert
med.text: Huwag kang mag-alala kay Rose, ganyan talaga siya. Marunong naman siya magturo, promise.

med.speaker: Papa Jobert
med.text: Alam mo, dito rin ako natutong mag-Akeanon dati. Parang paulit-ulit lang 'yung kwento, ha.

med.speaker: Papa Jobert
med.text: Sabihin mo kay Lola kung kailan ka na-tire. Alam mo naman siya, hindi siya titigil sa excitement.

med.speaker: Papa Jobert
med.text: Kung may makalimutan tayo, ako na bahala. Ikaw, focus ka lang sa pag-aaral.

high.speaker: Papa Jobert
high.text: Sobrang saya ni Lola ngayon, no? Sulit lahat ng jetlag para diyan.

low.speaker: Lola Susan
low.text: Halong, apo — mainit gid diri sa Aklan, indi pareho sa America.

low.speaker: Lola Susan
low.text: Kung gutom ka, sabihon mo lang. Damo pagkaon sa balay.

med.speaker: Lola Susan
med.text: Rose is a good girl, ha. Sharp lidah lang — sharp tongue. Her heart is bigger than that mouth.

med.speaker: Lola Susan
med.text: Sabihin mo sa akin kung ano pa gusto mong makita dito. Ipapakita ko lahat.
Kinukuha ni Lola Susan ang bag ni Player nang hindi man lang pinapayagan siyang tumanggi.

med.speaker: Lola Susan
med.text: Indi ka gid mabudlayan diri, Apo. Kilala ka namon tanan.

high.text: Ngumiti si Lola Susan, hinahaplos ang balikat ni Jonabel na parang natatakot pang mawala ulit ito.

high.speaker: Lola Susan
high.text: Dati pa, magkasama kami ni Jonabel sa lahat. Ngayon, ikaw naman ang kasama niya.

low.speaker: Rose
low.text: Wag mo akong tignan nang ganyan, hindi ako tour guide. ...okay, konti lang.

low.speaker: Rose
low.text: Magtuon ka gid, ha. Indi lang basta-basta.
Tumingin si Rose sa Player nang matagal, parang sinusukat kung seryoso ba talaga siya.

low.speaker: Rose
low.text: Wag kang mag-expect ng slack sa 'kin kasi pinsan ka daw ni Tita Susan. Rules apply to everyone.

med.speaker: Rose
med.text: My Lola Susan talks about your Lola Jonabel parang superhero pa. Big shoes to fill, balikbayan.

med.speaker: Rose
med.text: Fine, you're not completely hopeless. ...don't let that get to your head.

high.speaker: Rose
high.text: Alam mo, hindi ko rin naman gustong magturo dati. Pero, sige na nga.
Napailing si Rose, pero halatang pigil ang ngiti.

scene_0_on_game_start.speaker: Player
scene_0_on_game_start.text: Huh! Is Lola Jonabel still watching TV, I better go check.
